kind: Derived evidence extract; not the full artifact or complete raw trace

scopeAndDisposition.freshExecution: Safari only. Chrome and Firefox job rows in attempt 2 carry forward their original execution timestamps.
scopeAndDisposition.sampling: This externally started unchanged-source Safari-only rerun is an additional actual execution, outside the predeclared complete-workflow sampling protocol; it is not a fresh three-browser repair-proof sample.
scopeAndDisposition.originalAttempt1: Failed before application or pointer acceptance at appkit-import-begin. Its phase and failed result remain preserved; the native cause remains unresolved.
scopeAndDisposition.historicalMissingPress: The earlier SPN-106 third-launch conflict-Doc missing press retains an explicit unresolved historical cause; this later pass does not retroactively establish it.
scopeAndDisposition.currentCombinedSourceNativeValidation: Pending. This older-source external result is not final acceptance for a candidate that later integrates SPN-138 and current main.
scopeAndDisposition.spn138Boundary: SPN-138 is an ordinary browser shared-folder readiness repair, not an AppKit repair.
scopeAndDisposition.identityContract: SPN-130 requires identity within the existing bound or its actual failed phase, with cleanup authorized only after positive identity; no broader OS root-cause repair is claimed.
limits: One successful fresh Safari execution does not establish absence of future native delivery or identity failures.
The recorded long initial AppKit import establishes phase timing, not its cause or grounds for a longer timeout.
Storage loss is deliberate deletion through browser APIs, not a reproduced browser eviction heuristic.
Storage persistence was not granted; all four download records retain before=false and after=false.
This derived extract omits the complete probe automation log, original image bytes and some diagnostic caret fields; use the original artifact or maintained raw evidence for those details.

transformations: All 39 acceptance stages preserve their original name and timestamp.

The two native-doc-input-caret stages retain item identity, before/caret unit identity, selection endpoints, input connection/focus, pending-selection state, synthetic text and visual result; other repeated caret diagnostics and command histories are omitted.

For the 12 image records in normal reconnect and conflict-copy stages, original hexadecimal PNG bytes are decoded and replaced by byteLength and SHA-256; id and mime are preserved. Every derived SHA-256 equals its original image id. No original PNG byte string is embedded here.
All five pointer JSONL rows are retained verbatim as parsed JSON objects; key order and whitespace are reformatted by JSON serialization.

Capability-probe phase trace lines are parsed into phaseEvents without changing their at/phase values. derivedAppKitImportMs is the timestamp difference between appkit-import-begin and appkit-import-end. Identity stdout duplicates the retained identity object and is omitted.
Original member SHA-256 values and byte counts cover every non-directory ZIP member, independently compared byte-for-byte with the extracted local inputs.
Derived summary counts and pointer checks are computed from the retained original records, not substitute test executions.

acceptance.scope: Actual macOS ordinary-profile application restart, retained images/edits, reconnect and storage loss
